questions.stem: 對於那些一味追求流行的人來說，手機和衣服往往還能用就被丟掉了。
questions.answer: For those who blindly pursue trends, mobile phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still be used.
accepted_answers: For people who always chase the latest fashions, phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still be used.
For those who blindly follow fashion trends, mobile phones and clothes often get thrown away while they are still usable.

patterns: 對於…的人而言（For those who …）
被動語態（被丟掉、還能被使用）

questions.stem: 他們生活在一個廣告無所不在的社會，因此無論擁有多少，總覺得還不夠。
questions.answer: They live in a society where advertisements are all around, so no matter how much they possess, they never feel they have enough.
accepted_answers: They live in a society where advertising is everywhere, so no matter how much they own, they always feel it is not enough.
They live in a society in which ads can be seen everywhere, so no matter how much they have, it never seems enough.

patterns: 讓步：無論…（no matter how much）
關係副詞 where（廣告無所不在的社會＝a society where …）

1.explanation_zh: 「對於那些…的人來說」用 For those who＋V …；those 已經是「那些人」，後面不加 people。「流行」在這裡是名詞「潮流」，寫 trends／fashion。手機和衣服是「被丟掉」的，用被動 are thrown away；「還能用」也要用被動 can still be used（或 still work），用 even though 連接表讓步。
evidence: 對於那些一味追求流行的人來說
1.strategy_zh: 句首 For those who … 交代對象，主要子句以「手機和衣服」為主詞寫成被動，最後用 even though 補上「還能用」。
hints: 切成四段：對於那些一味追求流行的人來說／手機和衣服／還能用／就被丟掉了
標的詞彙：pursue（追求）、trend（流行）、phone（手機）、use（使用）、throw away（丟掉）
句型框架：For those who + V …, S + be + often + p.p. + even though …

2.explanation_zh: 「廣告無所不在的社會」的修飾語是完整子句（廣告無所不在），缺的是「在那裡」，用關係副詞 where（＝in which）：a society where advertisements are all around。「無論擁有多少」用 no matter how much＋S＋V，指總量用 much。「總覺得還不夠」補上主詞：they never feel they have enough。
2.strategy_zh: 主幹 They live in a society，後面接 where 子句；再用 so 接結果，結果句前面放 no matter how much 的讓步子句。
hints: 切成四段：廣告無所不在／的社會／無論擁有多少／總覺得還不夠
標的詞彙：advertisement（廣告）、society（社會）、possess（擁有）、enough（足夠的）
句型框架：S + live in a society where + S + V, so no matter how much + S + V, S + V …

references: For those who blindly pursue trends, mobile phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still be used.
For people who always chase the latest fashions, phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still be used.
For those who blindly follow fashion trends, mobile phones and clothes often get thrown away while they are still usable.

patterns.label_zh: 對於…的人而言（For those who …）
patterns.frame: For those who + V …, S + V …

patterns.label_zh: 被動語態（被丟掉、還能被使用）

parts.zh: 對於那些一味追求流行的人來說
accepted: For those who blindly pursue trends
For people who always chase the latest fashions
For those who blindly follow fashion trends
For those who blindly follow trends
For people who blindly follow trends

common_errors.wrong: For those people who blindly pursue trends
common_errors.right: For those who blindly pursue trends
common_errors.explanation_zh: those 本身就是「那些人」，後面不再加 people。

common_errors.wrong: For those who blindly pursue popular
common_errors.right: For those who blindly pursue trends
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「流行」在這裡是名詞（潮流），用 trends／fashion；popular 是形容詞。
「手機」是 mobile phone／cell phone，hand phone 是中式英文。
clothing 是不可數名詞，不加 s；或用 clothes。

accepted: even though they can still be used
while they can still be used

common_errors.wrong: even though they can still use
common_errors.right: even though they can still be used
common_errors.explanation_zh: 手機和衣服是「被使用」的，要用被動 can be used（或 still work）。

common_errors.wrong: even they can still be used
common_errors.right: even though they can still be used
common_errors.explanation_zh: 連接子句要用 even though；even 單獨不能當連接詞。
手機和衣服是「被丟掉」的，要用 be＋p.p.。
throw 的過去分詞是 thrown。

traps.literal_error: For those who blindly pursue popular,
traps.explanation_zh: 「追求流行」的「流行」是名詞「潮流」，英文用 trends／fashion；popular 是形容詞，不能當 pursue 的受詞。

traps.literal_error: mobile phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still use
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「還能用」沒有說出「誰用」；照字面寫 they can still use，they 指手機和衣服，就變成手機自己在使用東西，要改成被動 can still be used。

bonus.text: Those who blindly follow trends tend to throw away mobile phones and clothes that are still perfectly usable.
bonus.explanation_zh: 改用 Those who … 當主詞的主動句，加上 tend to（往往）與 perfectly usable（完全堪用），語意更清楚。

1.restructuring_zh: 「手機和衣服往往還能用就被丟掉了」中文先說「還能用」再說「被丟掉」，英文主要子句放前面 are often thrown away，再用 even though they can still be used 補充讓步。

references: They live in a society where advertisements are all around, so no matter how much they possess, they never feel they have enough.
They live in a society where advertising is everywhere, so no matter how much they own, they always feel it is not enough.
They live in a society in which ads can be seen everywhere, so no matter how much they have, it never seems enough.

patterns.label_zh: 讓步：無論…（no matter how much）
patterns.frame: No matter how much + S + V, S + V …

patterns.label_zh: 關係副詞 where（廣告無所不在的社會＝a society where …）

common_errors.explanation_zh: everywhere 是副詞，前面不加 in。
可數名詞 advertisement 泛指時用複數；不可數的寫法是 advertising。

common_errors.wrong: a society which advertisements are all around
common_errors.right: a society where advertisements are all around
common_errors.explanation_zh: 關係子句裡主詞、動詞齊全，缺的是地點，要用關係副詞 where（＝in which）。

common_errors.wrong: a society that advertisements are all around
common_errors.right: a society where advertisements are all around
common_errors.explanation_zh: that／which 在子句裡要當主詞或受詞，這裡缺的是「在那裡」，用 where。

accepted: no matter how much they possess
no matter how much they own
no matter how much they have

common_errors.wrong: no matter how many they possess
common_errors.right: no matter how much they possess
common_errors.explanation_zh: 這裡指擁有的東西總量，用 how much。

common_errors.wrong: no matter they possess how much
common_errors.right: no matter how much they possess
common_errors.explanation_zh: no matter 後面先接 how much，再接主詞動詞。

accepted: they never feel they have enough
they always feel it is not enough
they never feel it is enough

common_errors.right: they always feel it is not enough
common_errors.explanation_zh: feel 後面要有完整的主詞與補語；中文省略的主詞要補上。

common_errors.right: they never feel they have enough
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「覺得不夠」是覺得「擁有的不夠」，要寫 they have enough。

traps.explanation_zh: 「無所不在」是四字成語，英文說 are all around／are everywhere 即可；逐字翻成 exist in everywhere 會多出介系詞。

traps.literal_error: no matter how many they possess
traps.explanation_zh: 「擁有多少」指的是東西的總量，用 how much；how many 後面通常要接可數名詞複數。

bonus.text: Surrounded by advertisements, they never feel they have enough, however much they own.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用過去分詞構句 Surrounded by advertisements 交代背景，讓步改用 however much they own 放句尾，句構更緊湊。

2.restructuring_zh: 「廣告無所不在的社會」是有主詞、動詞的子句修飾名詞，英文改成放在名詞後面的關係副詞子句 a society where advertisements are all around。

1.translation: For those who blindly follow fashion trends, cell phones and clothes are often thrown away even though they can still be used.
1.explanation_zh: 「對於那些…的人來說」用 For those who…；「一味追求流行」blindly follow fashion trends；「還能用就被丟掉了」以被動 are often thrown away 加讓步子句 even though they can still be used 表達；中文的「就」也可理解成 before they wear out，所以信心給 medium。

2.translation: They live in a society where advertisements are everywhere, so no matter how much they own, they always feel it is not enough.
2.explanation_zh: 「廣告無所不在的社會」用關係副詞 where 引導的子句修飾 society；「無論擁有多少」用 no matter how much they own；「總覺得還不夠」they always feel it is not enough。

1.translation: For people who blindly chase after trends, phones and clothes are often thrown away while they are still usable.
1.explanation_zh: 「對於那些……的人來說」譯成 For people who...；「一味追求流行」譯成 blindly chase after trends；「還能用就被丟掉了」用被動式加 while they are still usable（表示仍能使用時即被丟棄）。

2.translation: They live in a society where advertisements are everywhere, so no matter how much they have, they always feel that it is not enough.
2.explanation_zh: 「廣告無所不在的社會」用 a society where advertisements are everywhere；「因此」用 so 連接；「無論擁有多少」用 no matter how much they have；「總覺得還不夠」譯成 always feel that it is not enough。

status_reason: 人工審核（兩位盲譯都通過，判定者改判退回）：第 1 句評分規準第 1 部分把文法正確的 For those people who blindly pursue trends 列為常見錯誤，說明寫「those 本身就是『那些人』，後面不再加 people」，explanations 第 1 句也寫同一條規則。those people who … 是正確英文（學測 109 選文本身就有 For those people who were born without …），而且正是「那些…的人」最直接的譯法；照這份規準會誤扣學生分數並教錯文法。要刪除這個常見錯誤、修正解析，並把 For those people who … 補進第 1 部分 accepted。
